discription: A warm sawtooth wave synth with a classic ADSR envelope and a low-pass filter for a smooth, rich sound.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, atk=0.01, dec=0.2, sus=0.7, rel=1.0, cutoff=5000, rq=0.5; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(atk, dec, sus, rel, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = Saw.ar(freq * [1.0, 1.005]); sig = LPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
